card.name: Inside brand drug names in dosing
card.fires_on: Partway through capitalized brand names of newer drugs (e.g. RYBREVANT, SPIRIVA, VORANIGO, NUCALA) in dosing and treatment instructions. It fires on the first or middle pieces of the name, right after verbs like interrupt, continue, discontinue.

modes.label: Start of brand name
modes.description: Opening piece of an all-caps brand name after an instruction verb or 'of'.

modes.label: Middle or end of brand name
modes.description: Later pieces of a split brand name in 'continue treatment with' or dose sentences.
modes.example: Continue treatment with ELREXF<<IO>> until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a capitalized brand drug name within dosing instructions, such as when to interrupt or continue a drug.
